mv x.go m/sub
-- x.go --
package m

import "fmt"

var Count int

func Hello() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("hello %d", Count)
}

type Config struct {
	Name string
}
-- main.go --
package m

var _ = Hello()

var _ = Config{Name: "test"}

var _ = Count
-- sub/sub.go --
package sub
